description: Checks that the trusted signing account name is valid and is not already in use.

operations.description: Checks that the trusted signing account name is valid and is not already in use.

schema.description: The parameters used to check the availability of the trusted signing account name.
schema.name: body

params.description: The ID of the target subscription. The value must be an UUID.
params.name: subscriptionId

consts.description: The API version to use for this operation.
consts.name: api-version

props.description: An error message explaining the Reason value in more detail.
props.name: message

props.description: A boolean value that indicates whether the name is available for you to use. If true, the name is available. If false, the name has already been taken or is invalid and cannot be used.
props.name: nameAvailable

props.description: The reason that a trusted signing account name could not be used. The Reason element is only returned if nameAvailable is false.
props.name: reason
